closure_rationale: The non-scientific fixture binding preflight passed.
No independent numerical minimum relevant effect was justified.
No independent numerical precision threshold was justified.
Therefore no scientifically defensible replication count can be frozen under the current specification.
Selecting a numerical count solely to enable execution would introduce an unsupported scientific design choice.
prohibitions: Do not execute the frozen fixture as a confirmatory scientific experiment under the current specification.
Do not treat the generator value 30 as a scientific replication count.
Do not backfill a replication count from NEXT2.
Do not infer a replication count from runtime, cost, or desired sample size.
Do not use future observed results to define the pre-execution criterion retrospectively.
scientific_reopening_condition: Scientific execution may be reconsidered only after an independently justified pre-execution replication criterion is established and a new authorization gate is passed.
final_interpretation: NEXT3 is methodologically closed and reproducibly frozen, but scientifically underdetermined with respect to replication count. This is a design closure, not scientific evidence for or against the NEXT3 hypothesis.
